intro.heading: Dispatches
intro.text: Long-form essays from the ice — reporting, analysis, and field notes on the changing cryosphere, polar geopolitics, and the craft of expedition leadership.

featured.title: Thin Ice: The Arctic Sea Ice Maximum of 2026 and the World That Depends on It
featured.excerpt: On March 15, the Arctic sea ice reached its 2026 maximum: 14.29 million km², the lowest in the 48-year satellite record. An area twice the size of Texas that never froze. The ice is telling its story.
